notes.title: Important Update
The Tool NewsPack Update
notes.content:
16 new objects is added with the Old Year News Pack. Each month of 2020 corresponds to a different news item. Check it out! The new objects is highlited by red color.

A new photo mode has also been added. It is activated by pressing the F6 key! 
Photo mode allows you to hide the game UI.
